feeds.title: The Flexitarian
feeds.description: Flexitarians (aka Flexible Vegetarians) have a plant-based diet. They helps you go meat free with its vegetarian and vegan recipes. Eat less meat , get healthy , save the planet.

feeds.title: It's a Veg World After All » Flexitarian
feeds.description: I'm Lizzie, a Registered Dietitian and cookbook author who loves vegetables. And I'm here to help you love them too! My easy, veggie-forward recipes will help you get comfortable in the kitchen and celebrate the seasons. The flexitarian recipes are loaded with veggies but also include a source of meat or seafood, such as chicken, ground beef, salmon, and shrimp.

feeds.title: Our Happy Mess » Mediterranean Diet/Flexitarian
feeds.description: I'm Ann and I believe in balanced eating, homemade foods, and DESSERT. I love to cook, but I can't spend all day in the kitchen anymore, so what you'll mostly find here are simple, family-friendly recipes. Find dozens of flexitarian recipes that are perfect if you're following the Mediterranean diet. Delicious plant-based, whole grain, seafood, and poultry recipes.

feeds.title: Georgie Eats
feeds.description: Welcome!! I'm Georgie, a freelance recipe developer, and food writer. Here at Georgie Eats, you will find an abundance of simple, vegan-ish recipes that use the best of seasonal ingredients to help you cook and eat more sustainably.

feeds.title: Flexitarian Kitchen
feeds.description: I am Ana Hruby, a flexitarian food aficionado and a passionate cook. My blog is minimalist in design and easy to navigate. What you will find are tried and tested flexitarian recipes high in flavor and low in labor. What you will not find is lifestyle advice, superfood merchandising, and my personal 'life story'.

feeds.title: Flexitarian Focus
feeds.description: Flexitarian Focus Magazine is dedicated to helping you live your best flexitarian life. Founders Alice Munro and Jack Lyndhurst are excited to share their mission of eating less meat, reducing the environmental impact of animal farming, and improving human health.

feeds.title: Mission Foods » Flexitarian
feeds.description: Mission, a subsidiary of Gruma Corporation, is the #1 tortilla company in the U.S. and manufactures a variety of authentic Mexican products. As we've grown, we've made sure to always put an emphasis on authentic flavors, while providing healthy options that families and friends can enjoy together. We suggest trying one of our Flexitarian recipes. Flexitarian is a combination of the words flexible and vegetarian and has become a popular lifestyle choice for people looking to eat healthier.

feeds.title: Lydia's Flexitarian Kitchen
feeds.description: Hey there! I'm Lydia and over the last couple of years I've become intrigued with the semi-vegetarian style of eating popularly known as 'flexitarian.' It's our desire to share recipes and techniques we've picked up over the years, especially with someone who is just learning to cook. More experienced cooks will find plenty of new recipes to try as well, with an emphasis on whole ingredients. So come on in and browse around.
